title: 'Get your bearings' gives directions relative to the CURRENT room, and the underlying map isn't a strict grid, so the same landmark's stated distance changes unpredictably between rooms (e.g. 'the cairn-track's foot: 1 north and 2 east' from one spot, then '2 north and 2 east' from the very next room after moving the 'right' way) — pure dead-reckoning without re-checking bearings at every step reliably sends you the wrong way.
